services.name: Our Charters
services.desc: We have a new site as well as a new boat for the 2019 Chesapeake Bay Fishing Season. We begin the 2019 Season on April 20 with the highly anticipated and ever popular Chesapeake Bay Trophy Striped Bass Season. This season runs April 20 - May 15 and offers anglers the opportunity at the larger migratory Striped Bass that are headed back out to the Atlantic Ocean after spawning in the Chesapeake Bay’s tributaries. These Trophy Striped Bass or Rockfish, as referred to by locals, are required by the state to be a minimum of 35″ to keep and anglers may keep (1) fish per person, per day. Beginning May 16, our striped bass size limit drops to a minimum 19″ fish and creel limit increases to (2)
